about_short: Founded in the fall of 1991, Laurel Moon is Brandeis University's oldest national literary publication. Each semester we put together a new issue of poetry, prose, and artwork by undergraduates from Brandeis and across the country.
name: Laurel Moon
about:
Founded in the fall of 1991, Laurel Moon is Brandeis University's oldest national literary publication. Each semester we put together a new issue of poetry, prose, and artwork by undergraduates from Brandeis and across the country.
